nodes.description: Admin address state variable; controls privileged admin functions such as _setImplementation.
Implementation contract address; target of delegatecall in delegateToImplementation and in the fallback.
Pending admin address set by _setPendingAdmin and accepted by _acceptAdmin.
Comptroller contract that enforces market risk policy.
Interest rate model contract used to compute borrow and supply rates.
Address of the underlying ERC-20 asset wrapped by this cToken.
Constructor: sets admin = msg.sender, delegatecalls initialize to the implementation, calls _setImplementation, then sets admin = admin_.
Public admin function that changes the implementation address, optionally resigning the old one; guarded only by msg.sender == admin.
Internal helper performing a low-level callee.delegatecall(data) with arbitrary target and calldata.
Public function that delegatecalls arbitrary data to the stored implementation address.
Public view function performing address(this).staticcall(delegateToImplementation(bytes)).
Payable fallback that delegatecalls msg.data to the implementation address and forwards return data.
External wrapper delegatecalling mint(uint256) to the implementation and decoding the returned uint.
Forwards a sweepToken(address) delegatecall to the implementation to rescue accidentally sent ERC-20 tokens.
Caller-controlled address; assigned to admin in the constructor and compared with admin in _setImplementation.
Low-level callee.delegatecall(data) inside delegateTo; arbitrary code executes in this contract's storage context.
Low-level implementation.delegatecall(msg.data) inside the fallback; routes all calldata to the implementation.
address(this).staticcall(delegateToImplementation(bytes)) inside delegateToViewImplementation.
State write implementation = implementation_ protected only by an admin check, with no timelock delay.
Parameter implementation_ of _setImplementation: the new implementation address.
Parameter allowResign of _setImplementation: flag controlling the _resignImplementation delegatecall.
Parameter becomeImplementationData of _setImplementation: encoded args forwarded to _becomeImplementation.
Parameter callee of delegateTo: arbitrary delegatecall target address.
Parameter data of delegateTo: raw calldata supplied to the delegatecall.
Parameter data of delegateToImplementation: raw calldata relayed into delegateTo.
Parameter mintAmount of mint: user-supplied underlying amount.
Parameter token of sweepToken: ERC-20 token address to sweep.
Local variable data in mint holding the delegatecall return bytes.
Local variable oldImplementation in _setImplementation caching the previous implementation address.
Local variable success flag returned by the low-level delegatecall in delegateTo.
Local variable returnData bytes returned by the low-level delegatecall in delegateTo.
Constructor parameter underlying_: address of the underlying asset encoded into initialize.
Constructor parameter admin_: final admin address assigned after initialization.

edges.reason: msg.sender is compared against admin in the require guard, so only the admin may change the implementation.
The constructor assigns admin = msg.sender, granting the deployer admin rights during initialization.
The implementation_ parameter flows directly into the implementation state variable assignment.
_setImplementation performs the implementation state write protected only by an admin require and no timelock.
allowResign controls whether _resignImplementation is delegatecalled.
becomeImplementationData is forwarded into the _becomeImplementation calldata.
oldImplementation local reads and caches the previous implementation address before the write.
_setImplementation calls delegateToImplementation to reach the implementation contract.
delegateToImplementation forwards execution to delegateTo.
The implementation state variable is used as the delegatecall target in delegateToImplementation.
The data parameter is relayed through delegateToImplementation into delegateTo.
The callee parameter is the arbitrary target of the low-level delegatecall, allowing attacker-supplied code.
The raw data parameter is executed via delegatecall in this contract's storage context.
delegateTo executes the unsafe callee.delegatecall(data) operation.
The success flag from the delegatecall is checked before returning or reverting.
returnData is returned to the caller or used in the revert path.
The delegatecall hands control to an arbitrary implementation that can re-enter the delegator.
The fallback delegatecalls msg.data to the implementation address held in storage.
The fallback performs the low-level delegatecall using user-supplied msg.data.
The delegatecall returns control to the fallback, permitting re-entrant calls.
delegateToViewImplementation performs the staticcall to itself.
The staticcall invokes delegateToImplementation(bytes) on this contract.
The constructor calls _setImplementation to register the initial implementation.
The constructor delegatecalls initialize(...) through delegateToImplementation.
The underlying_ constructor parameter is ABI-encoded into the initialize delegatecall.
The admin_ constructor parameter overwrites the admin state variable after initialization completes.
mintAmount is encoded into the delegatecall payload built in mint.
The delegatecall return bytes are stored and decoded in the mint local variable data.
The token address is encoded into the sweepToken delegatecall payload.
sweepToken forwards execution to delegateToImplementation.
mint forwards execution to delegateToImplementation.
The admin state variable is the authorization source consulted by _setImplementation.

normalization_plan.reason: implementation_ has no independent semantics; it exists only as the value written by _setImplementation into the implementation state variable.
allowResign is a local decision flag for the _resignImplementation delegatecall path and should be folded into _setImplementation.
becomeImplementationData is only used to build the _becomeImplementation calldata inside _setImplementation.
callee is exclusively the target of the unsafe low-level delegatecall and adds no separate semantics.
data is only the calldata argument consumed by the delegatecall in delegateTo.
The data parameter of delegateToImplementation is simply relayed into delegateTo and should collapse into it.
mintAmount is only ABI-encoded into the payload forwarded by mint.
token is only used to build the sweepToken(address) delegatecall payload.
The temporary bytes variable in mint only holds the decoded delegatecall result for that function.
oldImplementation is a transient cache of the old implementation used solely for the NewImplementation event.
success is a transient result flag of the delegatecall inside delegateTo.
returnData is a transient buffer holding delegatecall output before it is returned or reverted.
underlying_ is only ABI-encoded into the initialize delegatecall issued by the constructor.
admin_ is only used at the end of the constructor to overwrite the admin state variable.
